function openEditOrder(btn) { const d = btn.dataset; document.getElementById('editOrderTitle').textContent = 'Edit Order ' + d.name; document.getElementById('formEditOrder').action = '/adaptfit/admin/order/' + d.id + '/update'; document.getElementById('eo_partner').value = d.partner; document.getElementById('eo_garment').value = d.garment; document.getElementById('eo_fabric').value = d.fabric; document.getElementById('eo_urgency').value = d.urgency; document.getElementById('eo_artisan').value = d.artisan || ''; document.getElementById('eo_notes').value = d.notes || ''; document.getElementById('eo_total').value = d.total || 0; document.getElementById('eo_deposit').value = d.deposit || 0; document.getElementById('eo_mag').checked = !!d.mag; document.getElementById('eo_port').checked = !!d.port; document.getElementById('eo_flat').checked = !!d.flat; document.getElementById('eo_rise').checked = !!d.rise; document.getElementById('eo_tag').checked = !!d.tag; document.getElementById('modalEditOrder').classList.add('open'); } function openEditPatient(btn) { const d = btn.dataset; document.getElementById('editPatientTitle').textContent = 'Edit Patient: ' + d.name; document.getElementById('formEditPatient').action = '/adaptfit/admin/patient/' + d.id + '/update'; document.getElementById('ep_name').value = d.name || ''; document.getElementById('ep_email').value = d.email || ''; document.getElementById('ep_phone').value = d.phone || ''; document.getElementById('ep_notes').value = d.notes || ''; document.getElementById('ep_amp').checked = !!d.amp; document.getElementById('ep_stroke').checked = !!d.stroke; document.getElementById('ep_port').checked = !!d.port; document.getElementById('ep_wheel').checked = !!d.wheel; document.getElementById('ep_sens').checked = !!d.sens; document.getElementById('ep_mag').checked = !!d.mag; document.getElementById('ep_flat').checked = !!d.flat; document.getElementById('modalEditPatient').classList.add('open'); } function openEditQa(btn) { const d = btn.dataset; document.getElementById('editQaTitle').textContent = 'Edit QA: ' + d.name; document.getElementById('formEditQa').action = '/adaptfit/admin/qa/' + d.id + '/update'; document.getElementById('eq_seam').checked = !!d.seam; document.getElementById('eq_mag').checked = !!d.mag; document.getElementById('eq_port').checked = !!d.port; document.getElementById('eq_tol').checked = !!d.tol; document.getElementById('eq_reason').value = d.reason || ''; document.getElementById('modalEditQa').classList.add('open'); } function openEditSettlement(btn) { const d = btn.dataset; document.getElementById('editSettlementTitle').textContent = 'Edit Settlement: ' + d.name; document.getElementById('formEditSettlement').action = '/adaptfit/admin/settlement/' + d.id + '/update'; document.getElementById('es_bonus').value = d.bonus || 0; document.getElementById('es_penalty').value = d.penalty || 0; document.getElementById('modalEditSettlement').classList.add('open'); }
